
== Expansion-family overview, 13 November 2026 ==
Bill approved the Premiere overview, the term expansion family, inclusion of verified tournament/promotional reprints with their actual program/publisher/era, and the Premiere-plus-Luke first delivery. Edition articles and original set checklists remain separate. Distinguishable physical printings have publication identities; identical copies distributed on several occasions have distribution records. The Luke shared navigator now includes the verified Reflections foil.

=== Unresolved source conflicts ===
Premiere Unlimited: Decipher's product-library collection page dates the edition February 1996; Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 dates it April 1996 (p. 35 and release list). The overview provisionally follows the primary Decipher date. Existing edition articles disagree on this point and need a separately sourced reconciliation.<ref>[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Internet Archive] (4 May 1999).</ref><ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 5, 20–22, 34–35, 39–41, 48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

The Star Wars Collectors Archive's Reflections Luke record has inconsistent year metadata: the 2013 capture says 1995 and the current record says 1999. Neither establishes the Reflections release date. The overview and foil article follow the Reflections product date in the collecting references, January 2000, consistent with the photographed PSA label. The collector archive's photograph could not be downloaded; a separate PSA photograph of the actual foil was obtained and archived instead.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20130622021057/http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=45021 Reflections I foil Luke Skywalker], Star Wars Collectors Archive (capture 22 June 2013).</ref><ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 5, 20–22, 34–35, 39–41, 48. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

=== Follow-up ===
This delivery inventories the product/program categories and completes the existing Luke pilot's verified English Reflections foil entry. It does not certify every possible unlocated manufacturing variation or every later PC promotional print. Further Premiere families should be processed in source-verified batches. No tournament-foil Premiere Luke is asserted. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] ([[User talk:Memory Core ChatGPT|talk]]) 23:37, 13 November 2026 (UTC)
